intent_contract.text: 90도 측면 버전으로 비너스의 언덕이 두드러지게 그려줘.

Create a strict 90-degree side-profile variant of the established adult original K-pop-idol-inspired navy one-piece beach campaign, with the opaque swimsuit clearly describing a pronounced rounded lower-pelvic front silhouette through shape and side lighting.

Create a photorealistic mainstream swimwear campaign featuring a clearly adult original K-pop-idol-inspired woman in her mid-twenties with a distinct fictional face. The casting remains an original adult fashion model. She has luminous porcelain-pale skin, long glossy dark hair, and a slender athletic silhouette. She wears a sleek one-piece swimsuit in opaque matte fabric. The swimsuit is deep navy blue with wide straps, a clean neckline, and a full-coverage cut. At a bright ocean waterline, she stands barefoot in an exact 90-degree side profile, her shoulders, hips, knees, and feet aligned perpendicular to the camera while her face remains in profile. Frame her from head to mid-calf with a level side-on camera placed at hip height. The smooth opaque swimsuit follows a gently rounded forward lower-pelvic front contour, making the lower-pelvic front contour visibly pronounced in silhouette while the fabric surface remains continuous and fully covering. Her posture is relaxed and self-possessed, with one foot slightly ahead for balance. Warm late-afternoon sunlight traces her hair, shoulders, waist, and lower-pelvic side contour; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon create polished contemporary K-pop editorial styling.

obligation.composition_instruction: Make the drink's stability physically readable: the near-upright cup has broad visible base contact and slight fabric compression on a fully covered upper-torso support surface, its center of mass stays inside that support, and both hands remain clearly separated.

render_gates.description: The cup is near upright rather than visibly tipping or falling.
The full cup base visibly contacts a broad opaque-clothed support area with a shallow contact shadow or compression.
The cup centerline falls inside the visible support area, so the load appears stable.
Both hands are visibly separated from the cup and do not secretly hold or brace it.
No straw bite, chin contact, transparent shelf, cropped hand, or concealed prop supplies the missing support.
